newsitem.title: GERMANY: Coconut oil exports seen rising in 96/97-Oil World.
newsitem.headline: Coconut oil exports seen rising in 96/97-Oil World.

text.p: Global exports of coconut oil may rise to 1.5 million tonnes in 1996/97 (Oct/Sept), around 130,000 tonnes up from 95/96, the independent Oil World newsletter said.
The publication cited expectations of higher Philippine and Indonesian shipments in the Jan-Sept 1997 period as well as improved Philippine copra yields and output.
Out of the 96/97 world total, the Philippines should account for an estimated 975,000 tonnes (899,000 in 95/96) and Indonesia for 350,000 tonnes (298,000).
Coconut oil prices in Europe were historically high and at a premium over palmkernel oil because a recovery in imports in early 1997 had been slower than expected, Oil World said.
But prices may come under pressure if output and export at origin increase and this could boost consumption in the period up to September.
This in turn could boost the use and the price of other laurics.
